what: A printed design table: the annual-maximum Hs fits of Bhaskaran, Verma, Goupee, Bhattacharya, Nejad and Shi (2023) for the five South Atlantic lease areas of their forty (LA12–LA16: Uruguay and Brazil), transcribed digit for digit from Table 1 (the coordinates) and Table 3 (the parameters) of the published PDF pinned below, read on 2026-09-29. Values are strings: the printed digits are the claim, and the box they allow is what certs/design-table-audit.json decides. The other thirty-five lease areas (North America, Europe, Asia) are not transcribed: the atlas's lattice there is 4°, too coarse to name a nearest node for a coastal site.

source.citation: Bhaskaran, S. K., Verma, A. S., Goupee, A. J., Bhattacharya, S., Nejad, A. R., Shi, W. (2023). Comparison of Extreme Wind and Waves Using Different Statistical Methods in 40 Offshore Wind Energy Lease Areas Worldwide. Energies 16(19), 6935.

data: WaveClimate (Infoplaza), a commercial portal: WAVEWATCH III offshore with a wave-ray model (SWRT) for nearshore translations, calibrated with satellites; Hs every 3 h, 1 January 1992 to 31 December 2022; 'the latitude and longitude coordinates were rounded off to ±0.5° by the website' (§2.2). Not public: the series behind this table cannot be re-run by anyone outside the portal.
block: annual maxima, one per calendar year (§2.3): 31 values

methods.gumbelMOM: Gumbel by the method of moments, β = √6 s/π, µ = mean − 0.577β (Eqs. 3–4)

conventions: Gumbel F = exp(−e^{−(x−µ)/β}) (Eq. 2): (µ, β) as this repository writes it. GEV F = exp(−(1 − k(x−µ)/σ)^{1/k}) (Eq. 1), WAFO's and Hosking's sign: k = −ξ, so the printed k is decided as ξ with its sign changed (the box of '−0.14' is the box of '0.14' negated, exactly). As printed, Eq. 6 (the GEV quantile, x_q = µ − (σ/k)[(ln p)^k − 1] with p the exceedance probability) is not that law's quantile, which has (−ln(1 − p))^k; nothing here uses it.
printedText: Table 1 prints minutes with a prime the PDF's text layer renders as '0' ("34◦ 140 S" is 34° 14′ S); the transcription reads the prime.
§3.1: 'LA16 (Projeto Ubu, Brazil) had the least mean annual maximum HS of 2.27 m.'
